(a) Main landing gear wheels (i.e., those nearest the airplane center of gravity) shall be of an approved type. (b) The rated static load of each main wheel shall not be less than the design weight for ground loads (§ 3.242) divided by the number of main wheels. Nose wheels shall have been tested for an ultimate radial load not less than the maximum nose wheel ultimate load obtained in the ground loads requirements, and for corresponding side and burst loads.
